exp01_decision.reason: EXP01 is the best first controlled experiment because the main weakness is Head 2 attack-family classification, the MLP attack head is already supported safely, outputs are isolated, and stronger alternatives require new code or higher-risk prep.

likely_causes: DoS-SlowHTTPTest and FTP-BruteForce overlap in the current flow-statistical feature space
Web-BruteForce, Web-XSS, and SQL-Injection have very low support and high variance
linear Head 2 may be too weak for non-linear attack-family boundaries
current 77 flow features may not include application/content detail for web and SQL attacks
shared encoder is optimized jointly for an easier binary task and harder attack-family task

candidate_rankings.expected_benefit: directly improves Head 2 boundary capacity while preserving Head 1
more capacity if the modest MLP underfits

candidate_rankings.expected_risk: may disrupt Head 1 and routing tradeoffs

candidate_rankings.expected_benefit: focuses on hard examples and overlapping classes
candidate_rankings.expected_risk: needs new implementation and tuning discipline

candidate_rankings.expected_benefit: increases exposure for rare and difficult attack families
candidate_rankings.expected_risk: overfitting and leakage risk if not strictly train-only

candidate_rankings.expected_benefit: could target rare/hard classes without architecture change
could directly target SlowHTTPTest/FTP and web/SQL specialists
could improve operating behavior without test tuning
candidate_rankings.expected_risk: not the main first lever and must avoid test leakage

candidate_rankings.expected_benefit: could add service/app signals for web and SQL attacks
candidate_rankings.expected_risk: new preprocessing protocol and comparability break

recommended_sequence: EXP01: run prepared Head 2 MLP capacity experiment
EXP02: if needed, prepare a stronger Head 2 branch
EXP03: if needed, prepare conservative attack_loss_weight adjustment
EXP04: if needed, prepare Head 2 focal loss
EXP05: if needed, prepare train-only attack-balanced sampler
EXP06: if needed, prepare train-only class-weight tuning
EXP07: if needed, prepare SlowHTTPTest/FTP specialist
EXP08: if needed, prepare Web/SQL specialist or guarded routing
EXP09: if needed, prepare validation-only calibration
EXP10: confirm the best candidate across multiple seeds
do_not_do: do not run EXP01 without main-control approval
do not tune thresholds on the test set
do not rerun randomly until lucky
do not change taxonomy to inflate metrics
do not use validation/test labels for class weights or samplers
do not overwrite the accepted baseline checkpoint or results
do not combine multiple new improvements in one uncontrolled run
do not copy V1 model-zoo routing directly into V2
